item.title: Gamcheon Culture Village, Busan (2026 Guide): Hours, Free Entry, Toseong Station Exit 6 Bus & Parking
item.description: Gamcheon Culture Village (감천문화마을) has no entry fee and is open every day of the year. The Busan Tourism Organization lists visiting hours as 09:00–18:00 from March to October and 09:00–17:00 from November to February, and the village information center is open 09:00–18:00. The usual way in is Line 1 to Toseong Station, Exit 6, then a village bus up the hill. Everything below comes from the village’s official website (gamcheon.or.kr) and the official Busan tourism site, checked on November 8, 2026.

item.title: Don't Rely on Google Maps Alone in Korea: Naver Map & KakaoMap Guide (2026)
item.description: A map app is one of the first things to set up before a trip to Korea. In most countries Google Maps is all you need, but in Korea it’s much easier with Naver Map or KakaoMap installed as well. (As of November 5, 2026)

item.title: Busan Fireworks Festival 2026 (Nov 7): Show Times, Which Subway Exit to Use & Ticket Deadline
item.description: The 21st Busan Fireworks Festival takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, across Gwangalli Beach, Igidae and Dongbaekseom Island. The main show, the Busan Multi Fireworks Show, runs 19:25–19:55. Everything below is based on the official website (busanfireworks.com), checked on November 5, 2026.
